body: CommunityAmerica Federal Credit Union filed two lawsuits in Hennepin County District Court against the owners of two office buildings in the Metropoint business park in St. Louis Park, Minnesota, the Minneapolis/St. Paul Business Journal reported, according to Connect CRE's July 23, 2026 roundup. The buildings are Metropoint 300, at 300 Highway 169 S., and Metropoint 400, at 400 Highway 169 S. The credit union is seeking to recover roughly $46 million in loans tied to the properties.
Both buildings were scheduled to be sold at a foreclosure auction in September 2026. The report did not name the owners or say why the loans went into default.
